description:
HushTelegram v0.0.8 targets telegram.org's Telegram 12.10.6 (org.telegram.messenger.web) and the official beta 12.10.7 (org.telegram.messenger.beta) with 22 patches. It takes sponsored messages, search ads, Stories, recommendations and the Premium, gifts and Stars upsells out of Telegram, and keeps its usage reports on your phone. New this time: a Notifications status page, a switch that stops a pull at the bottom of a channel from opening the next unread one, and optional patches for your own registered Telegram API ID and Google Maps key.

If Telegram won't send you a login code, register an app at my.telegram.org/apps and fill in Use registered Telegram API credentials before patching. For notifications, open Telegram's Settings, then Notifications and Sounds, and turn on Keep-Alive Service and Background Connection.

Validation: 554 runtime tests passed locally. All 278 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lints. All 22 patches applied to Telegram 12.10.6 and the 12.10.7 beta without forcing, and the resource and injected-code checks passed. The patched app signed in and ran on an Android 16 phone.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.33.0 or newer. Patch telegram.org's Telegram 12.10.6, version code 71129, or the beta 12.10.7, version code 71159. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Telegram APK. Uninstall the stock Telegram first, and keep the manager's signing key for updates.
